plugins.name: Unit Converter
plugins.description: Convert length, mass and temperature with a terminal-styled UI that follows your active KAEL theme. The official minimal example plugin.

plugins.name: Creative & Dev Utilities
plugins.description: Seven creative & dev tools in one panel with an internal tab strip: sketchboard canvas (pen/shapes/text/eraser/undo/pan-zoom/PNG), flowchart builder (SVG+PNG export), local heuristic font identifier, real sharp-backed image compressor, honest image/pdf converter with an explicit unsupported list, code-to-image renderer, and an npm package size checker — the only tool that touches the network (keyless bundlephobia/npm lookups, disclosed in-panel).
